Type: implementation task
Work key: CX04
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: With no file selected, half the release page is an empty "Select a file" card.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Show a compact overview: files by datatype/modality, admission state, findings by family with Fix-able count, and links into each.
2. When CX05 provenance is available, add the acceptance reason, who accepted, and changes since the previous release; until then omit those rows (no placeholders).
3. Overview never blocks or delays tree interaction; phone layout stacks cleanly.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (releaseView)
set.title: CX04: Replace the empty inspector with a release overview
